events.text: OFAC adds three entities to the Iran-related sanctions list following further oil-shipment seizures.
Two major container lines confirm extended Cape of Good Hope diversions through Q4 2026.
APRA publishes 2026 climate stress-test results; three of four majors below required capital under the severe scenario.
AEMO confirms 850 MW grid-scale battery commissioned in Victoria, financing closed.
Major WA fabrication facility postpones $1.2bn final investment decision, citing uncertainty.
US–Iran back-channel talks reported to resume, though Hormuz flows remain well below baseline.
